summary: A video said to be AI-generated, showing a police officer punching a person, was shared on social media as real footage of police violence at student protests in France. The clip predated the protests and its creator said it was made with AI.
technical_summary: A synthetic video created with generative image/video tools was repackaged by social media users as authentic protest footage. summary: A research study found that Google Search showed fewer abortion clinics in results for searches made from poorer and rural areas, including places with restrictive clinic laws, while crisis pregnancy centers often appeared as the closest option.
technical_summary: Researchers ran abortion-related queries from 467 US locations weekly for 14 weeks. Google's location-based search ranking returned fewer abortion clinic results for poorer, rural and TRAP-law areas, and crisis pregnancy centers were often the closest listed result. Performance improved after a major algorithm update.

summary: An image claiming to show a new 5,000-naira banknote with Nigeria's president circulated on social media. Fact-checkers found it was made with an AI tool, and the central bank denied issuing such a note.
technical_summary: A generative image tool tied to the X platform (Grok) produced a realistic banknote image. Users cropped out the tool's watermark and shared it with a false claim about the central bank. The output was used to mislead, with no provenance safeguards stopping the spread.

summary: Scammers ran a worldwide investment fraud campaign using social media ads and AI-powered video testimonials featuring famous people, luring victims to phishing sites and then taking their money and personal data.
technical_summary: The Nomani campaign combined malvertising on social platforms, branded posts and AI-generated video testimonials of celebrities to drive victims to phishing sites. Collected contact data was used for phone follow-up, fake investment portals, fee demands and further data harvesting. Activity grew over 335% between H1 and H2 2024.

summary: A man with a rare complication of leukemia reportedly relied on an AI search chatbot's account of medical research and delayed recommended treatment for about a year. His son says the chatbot misstated the studies and that it may have hastened his death.
technical_summary: An AI answer engine summarizing medical literature allegedly misrepresented cited research. The patient treated the output as authoritative, self-diagnosed and postponed oncologist-recommended therapy. The failure combined inaccurate generated content with over-reliance on it for a high-stakes medical decision.

summary: A fake video, probably made with AI, showed a famous podcaster seemingly endorsing a libido supplement. It ran as a TikTok ad and went viral on Twitter before TikTok removed it and banned the account.

summary: A lawyer for a bank filed an appeals court brief containing four nonexistent cases found with a Google AI search tool and not verified. The court struck the brief and referred the matter for attorney discipline.
technical_summary: An attorney used a generative AI search tool to find case law and filed the resulting citations without checking them. The tool produced fabricated authorities, and the brief passed internal signatory review. The court discovered the citations during its own review and sanctioned the filing.
